title: Towards Schrödinger Cat States in the Second Harmonic Generation
summary: We investigate the quantum evolution of the pump field in second-harmonic generation under strong pump depletion. Starting from a coherent state, the pump develops a nonclassical phase-space structure resembling a Schrödinger cat state. This behavior originates from phase instability induced by vacuum fluctuations of the harmonic mode. A rigorous quantum analysis has been performed for mean photon numbers up to $\langle \hat n \rangle = 100$ in pump mode. For larger photon numbers, up to $\langle \hat n \rangle = 10^{7}$, the dynamics have been analyzed using a classical trajectory method…
